templates.name: Supplier invoice processing
templates.description: Accounts payable receives supplier invoices, matches them with the purchase order and the goods receipt, gets them approved and schedules the payment.

steps.name: Receive the supplier invoice
steps.description: Collect invoices that arrive by email, post and the supplier portal into one queue

steps.name: Capture the invoice data
steps.description: Type the supplier, the invoice number, the dates, the lines and the tax into the ERP
problems: a different layout for each supplier

steps.name: Match the invoice with the purchase order and the goods receipt
steps.description: Compare quantities and prices of the invoice with the order and what the warehouse received
steps.input_description: Recorded invoice, purchase order and goods receipt
steps.output_description: Matched invoice or a list of differences

steps.name: Resolve price and quantity differences
steps.description: Ask the buyer or the supplier about each difference and agree on a credit note or a correction
problems: questions to suppliers answered by email after days

steps.name: Approve the invoice for payment
steps.description: The budget owner accepts the matched invoice

steps.name: Schedule the payment
steps.description: Add the approved invoice to the payment run by its due date
problems: changes to supplier bank details checked by phone

templates.name: Purchase orders to suppliers
templates.description: Purchasing turns material requirements into purchase orders, gets them approved, sends them to suppliers and follows them up until the goods arrive.

steps.name: Collect the purchase requests
steps.description: Gather the material needs from the planning run and the requests sent by email
problems: urgent requests outside the planning run

steps.name: Choose the supplier and the price
steps.description: Pick the supplier for each item from the agreed suppliers and their price lists
steps.output_description: Supplier and price for each item

steps.name: Create the purchase order
steps.description: Enter the order with the items, prices and delivery dates
steps.input_description: Supplier and price for each item

steps.name: Approve orders above the limit
steps.description: A manager accepts orders whose value is above the buyer's limit
problems: approvals wait while the manager travels

steps.name: Send the order and record the confirmation
steps.description: Send the order to the supplier and record the delivery date the supplier confirms

steps.name: Follow up late deliveries
steps.description: Chase suppliers whose deliveries are late and agree on a new date
steps.output_description: New delivery date or an alternative supplier

templates.name: Customer order entry
templates.description: Sales support receives customer orders in many formats, enters them in the ERP, checks price and credit, confirms the delivery date and sends the confirmation.

steps.name: Receive the customer order
steps.description: Collect orders that arrive by email, PDF and the customer portal
problems: each customer sends a different format

steps.name: Enter the order in the ERP
steps.description: Type the customer, the items, the quantities and the requested dates

steps.name: Check the price and the credit limit
steps.description: Compare the order with the price list and the credit limit of the customer

steps.name: Confirm the delivery date with planning
steps.description: Check stock and production capacity and agree on a date

steps.name: Send the order confirmation
steps.description: Send the customer the confirmed items, prices and date
